header.note: CounterFact pool of the cluster run: the 3,741 candidate pairs the production CF builder made from cf_records.json (prod/steer/data.py build_cf, then the runner's pos0 = exclude). The filters are applied on the Ouro tokenizer (ByteDance/Ouro-1.4B tokenizer.json, no BOS), not before tokenization: (1) records of relations P17, P103, P364, P641, P176 with at least one paraphrase prompt, split by subject half (int(sha256('cf-split:' + subject)[:8], 16) % 2; 0 = dev, 1 = test; pairs only inside a half); (2) the answer ' ' + target_true is one Ouro token; (3) pairs within one relation and one prompt template, record A paired with the next records of the template in case-id order, at most 5 partners per record A (window 5), skipping pairs whose Ouro prompts differ in length, whose answer tokens are equal, whose subjects are equal, or whose differing token span (common prefix and suffix removed) is empty or of unequal length: 9,125 pairs; (4) pos0 = exclude: pairs whose differing span starts at position 0 of the Ouro prompt (the subject opens the prompt) are removed: 5,384 removed, 3,741 kept. No sampling, cap or quota. On another tokenizer a pair is kept when its answers are single, different tokens and prompts A and B have equal length with an aligned source span (cluster/pilot/cf_pool.py); the model's own clean filter follows.
